This is a randomized trial where 30 adult patients received randomly assigned doses of Org 25969 (sugammadex) (0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 6.0 mg/kg) for reversal of rocuronium-induced block. Meets criteria as an RCT comparing different sugammadex doses.
